India objects to NYT's 'Pakistani Kashmir' reference

India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) has objected to The New York Times' use of the term 'Pakistani Kashmir' in a headline. The MEA stated that the nomenclature used by the newspaper was incorrect. The ministry called for the correct terminology to be used in reference to the region.
